messages:
maria: Quick check — I pushed a terraform change to reduce Karpenter maxSurge from 4 -> 2 and adjusted evictionGraceSeconds on inference pods from 120 -> 30. Can someone sanity-check? Concern: existing HPA bursts might cause rapid scale down & node churn.

sam: Noted. Did you update the provisioner TTL/idle buffer? If buffer too low, with shorter eviction grace we'll kill pods quicker and cause restarts.

kevin: Also, which metrics adapter feeds the HPA? We previously had a metrics read failure when the Vault secret path was renamed. That caused HPAs to stop scaling.

maria: Metrics adapter = prometheus-adapter (k8s-metrics namespace). I updated the env var to point at secret/data/infra/metrics but haven't rolled the adapter yet. Provisioner ttl_seconds_after_empty = 60 in this change.

jen: Please avoid rolling the adapter during business hours. Suggest we canary the Karpenter + adapter changes in inference-canary first and run a 5m burst loadtest to observe HPA behavior.

sam: Agree. Quick terraform plan looked fine but add a conservative scale-down buffer on the provisioner. If PDBs block evictions, we end up with pods stuck and new nodes created — churn. Consider ttl_seconds_after_empty=60 + consolidation=true and a small overprovision buffer.

maria: Pasted tf snippet from the PR: 
```hcl
resource "karpenter_provisioner" "inference" {
  name = "inference"
  ttl_seconds_after_empty = 60
  consolidation = true
  provider {
    maxSurge = 2
  }
}
```
Does that look sane?

kevin: Quick nit: our module expects provider settings under the module's provider_settings map, not a raw provider block. Also ensure nodeSelector / tolerations keep GPU workloads on the GPU pool (label: "node.kubernetes.io/instance-type=gpu") — otherwise inference and training mix.

infra-bot: terraform plan for infra/karpenter completed — 4 resources to change, 0 secrets changed. Plan ID: plan-20240314-89f3.

jen: If it's only 4 resources, include a safe-rollout tag and schedule canary window tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC. I'll run the canary harness and watch HPA metrics, pod evictions, and kube-events.

maria: Thanks. I'll open the PR with the module-compatible provider_settings shape, add the canary job + a short k6 loadtest, and set up a staged rollout for the prometheus-adapter (canary ns first). Tagging @sam @kevin for review. I won't roll the adapter until canary passes.

sam: I'll review the PR after lunch. One more suggestion — set HPA.stabilizationWindowSeconds to 30s and scaleDown.cooldown to 60s to reduce oscillation with shorter evictionGrace.

kevin: Ack. Also double-check VPA: for inference namespace we should keep VPA in "Off" (we use manual suggestions) to avoid autosizer conflicts.

jen: Noted. I'll add a runbook reminder to check kube-events and node-provisioner logs during the canary. If we see event spikes > 50/min or >80% node churn, abort.

maria: All right — creating PR now. Thanks for the quick checks :thumbsup:
